name: deciding an investment
from: Product lines that exist because they already existed: the funding body below deciding each checkpoint honestly, inside a portfolio nobody chose, with nothing above it to say the whole line is no longer worth a checkpoint at all.
to: An explicit decision, above the product line, that a line or venture is worth opening, worth continuing at its present scale, or worth closing — bounding what the checkpoint body below may fund, so that its go decisions spend from an allocation the firm actually made.
cost: Saying no at the largest grain, where every no is someone's whole line of work and the sunk cost argues loudest — a cost in stomach more than in hours.
otherwise: The checkpoint body inherits an unbounded purse: each individual go defensible, the sum an unchosen strategy, and the firm's direction set by the accumulation of local decisions nobody is answerable for.
